subject: Joint roadmap slate: initial MAP doc + slides for ArchAI evaluation
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@archai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Joint roadmap slate: initial MAP doc + slides for ArchAI evaluation

Hi Liam —

Great speaking yesterday. Per our call I pulled together a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) and a short slide outline so we can align on scope, owners, and a target close cadence. The doc is intentionally sparse — I want us to capture the key decision gates and the minimum acceptance criteria so procurement and engineering can move in parallel.

What you'll find in the GDoc:
- 30/60 day milestones (technical validation, pilot, acceptance)
- Stakeholder roster and owner suggestions
- Procurement asks and evidence list (SOC2 + export controls)
- Suggested workshop agenda for a 90-minute kickoff

Please review the MAP-starter-v0.gdoc (Drive link below) and the slide skeleton for the internal exec readout. Two asks from our side so we can finalize the version before the workshop:
1) Can you confirm the primary stakeholders (technical + procurement) and availability for a workshop the week of Apr 17?
2) Procurement timeline — what internal review window should we expect for a standard SOW/PO?

Attachments / links:
- MAP-starter-v0.gdoc (live): https://drive.google.com/open?id=MAP-starter-v0
- MAP-slides-outline-v1.pptx (attached)
- Attachment: MAP-starter-v0.gdoc (Google Drive)

I'll loop Jonas for success-plan alignment and Marissa/Ben for the technical validation slots once we have stakeholders. If you prefer, I can convert the MAP into a simple checklist HubSpot record as well.

Thanks — look forward to your notes.

—Priya
Priya Natarajan
Manager, GTM Solutions
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: MAP-slides-outline-v1.pptx)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@archai.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@archai.com
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint roadmap slate: initial MAP doc + slides for ArchAI evaluation

Hi Priya —

Thanks for pulling this together, the MAP looks like the right shape. A few quick notes from procurement and the technical leads:

- Stakeholders:
  * Liam O'Connor — Head of ML Platforms (liam.oconnor@archai.com)
  * Nora Patel — Dir, Security & Compliance (nora.patel@archai.com)
  * Rajiv Menon — Eng Lead, Integrations (rajiv.menon@archai.com)
  * procurement@archai.com (procurement contact)

- Procurement timeline: we typically run a 10–14 business day review for standard SaaS SOWs if there are no special terms. If legal asks for custom indemnities it can add 1–2 weeks.

- Evidence: please include the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and a high-level data flow diagram that shows no PHI/PII leaves our environment. Nora asked specifically for export control confirmation for the LLM weights (we'll need the vendor statement).

- Workshop: week of Apr 17 works for the core team on our side; morning PT is preferable.

I attached a procurement-checklist our team uses; happy to walk through it during the workshop.

Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of ML Platforms, ArchAI
(Attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@archai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Apr 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint roadmap slate: initial MAP doc + slides for ArchAI evaluation

Thanks, Liam — this is super helpful.

On Tue, Apr 11, 2028 at 1:05 PM Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@archai.com> wrote:
> - Procurement timeline: we typically run a 10–14 business day review for standard SaaS SOWs if there are no special terms.
> - Evidence: please include the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and a high-level data flow diagram...

I've updated the MAP with a dedicated procurement checklist section and a slot for the SOC2 artifact (link placeholder). Marissa and Ben — can you review the "technical validation" milestone and add a short acceptance checklist (smoke tests, latency targets, kv-cache behavior, and integration points)? Ben — specifically can you estimate how many engineering hours we'd need for the API shim + sample data pipeline?

Proposed high-level dates (tentative):
- Workshop: Apr 18 (90-min kickoff, workshop agenda pinned in the GDoc)
- Technical validation window: Apr 19–May 3
- Pilot run (canary): target May 8–May 22
- Target PO/close: by May 1–May 5 (depends on procurement review)

If the procurement window is 10–14 business days, we should plan to have legal + SOW draft to procurement by Apr 16 to aim for early May PO.

Drive & attachments updated:
- MAP-starter-v1 (updated): https://drive.google.com/open?id=MAP-starter-v1
- MAP-slides-outline-v1.pptx (minor edits attached)

I'll prep a 2-slide "what we need from ArchAI" pre-read for the workshop and share it by EOW. Jonas — can you own success criteria tracking (acceptance matrix + rolling checklist) once Marissa adds the tech items?

—Priya
Priya Natarajan
Manager, GTM Solutions
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: MAP-starter-v1.gdoc)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Apr 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint roadmap slate: initial MAP doc + slides for ArchAI evaluation

Priya / team — quick technical notes inline in the GDoc. Highlights:

- I've added a short telemetry & SLIs section (token latency p50/p95, error budget, correct response rate for the 10 test prompts).
- For the API shim + sample pipeline I'm estimating ~3 engineering days + 2 QA days for a minimal integration test harness (assuming ArchAI provides a staging dataset).
- Included a stub "integration test runbook" (technical-runbook-stub.md) as an attachment; it lists the smoke tests and post-deploy validation steps.

I recommend we keep the pilot window to 2 weeks and lock the acceptance matrix before starting. If procurement needs redacted SOC2, we'll attach it to the same Drive folder and flag it to Nora.

I'll join the workshop and can lead the tech validation breakout.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: technical-runbook-stub.md)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@archai.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@archai.com
Date: Thu, 13 Apr 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint roadmap slate: initial MAP doc + slides for ArchAI evaluation

Priya —

This looks good. Confirming:
- Workshop: Apr 18, 9:30–11:00 PT (please send Zoom invite + pre-read).
- Stakeholders: Nora (security) and Rajiv (integrations) will attend the relevant breakouts.
- Procurement will aim to get a PO to you by Apr 30 if we receive a clean SOW by Apr 16.

I'll ask procurement to review the checklist you linked and we'll surface any issues during the workshop. Looking forward to the session.

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of ML Platforms, ArchAI
